subtitle_zh: 今天是我们乘坐 公主邮轮的发现号从加拿大温哥华出发后的第五天，
subtitle_en: Day five from Vancouver on Discovery Princess,
notes: draft row 1 segment 1/2; source time 0:00:00.; rdo timing from measured cue WAV duration.

subtitle_zh: 我们来到了阿拉斯加的史凯威。
subtitle_en: we arrived in Skagway, Alaska.
notes: draft row 1 segment 2/2; source time 0:00:00.; rdo timing from measured cue WAV duration.

subtitle_zh: 另外三艘邮轮也陆续抵达了 史凯威。
subtitle_en: Three other ships also reached Skagway.
notes: draft row 2 segment 1/4; source time 1:19:02.; rdo timing from measured cue WAV duration.

subtitle_zh: 我们的 公主邮轮的发现号今天没有直接靠岸，
subtitle_en: Discovery Princess did not dock today,
notes: draft row 2 segment 2/4; source time 1:19:02.; rdo timing from measured cue WAV duration.

subtitle_zh: 需要乘接驳船上岸。
subtitle_en: so we went ashore by tender.
notes: draft row 2 segment 3/4; source time 1:19:02.; rdo timing from measured cue WAV duration.

subtitle_zh: 这与几年前港口发生的山体滑坡以及码头安全限制有关。
subtitle_en: This relates to past landslides and dock limits.
notes: draft row 2 segment 4/4; source time 1:19:02.; rdo timing from measured cue WAV duration.

subtitle_zh: 这里是历史悠久的 白隘口火车站。
subtitle_en: This is the historic White Pass station.
notes: draft row 3; source time 4:25:20.; rdo timing from measured cue WAV duration.

subtitle_zh: 这台巨大的机器是 白隘口铁路使用过的旋转式除雪车，
subtitle_en: This huge machine is a White Pass rotary snowplow,
notes: draft row 4 segment 1/2; source time 4:52:16.; rdo timing from measured cue WAV duration.

subtitle_zh: 前方的巨大叶轮专门用来清除山间铁路上的厚雪。
subtitle_en: built to clear deep snow from the mountain tracks.
notes: draft row 4 segment 2/2; source time 4:52:16.; rdo timing from measured cue WAV duration.

subtitle_zh: 从这里开始，我们沿着 史凯威 最著名的 百老汇大街慢慢往前走。
subtitle_en: From here, we walk down Skagway's Broadway.
notes: draft row 5; source time 5:07:17.; rdo timing from measured cue WAV duration.

subtitle_zh: 前面带有金色圆顶的是 史凯威 著名的 黄金北方酒店，
subtitle_en: Ahead is Skagway's Golden North Hotel,
notes: draft row 6 segment 1/2; source time 5:35:00.; rdo timing from measured cue WAV duration.

subtitle_zh: 也是 百老汇上很容易辨认的历史建筑。
subtitle_en: an easy landmark on Broadway.
notes: draft row 6 segment 2/2; source time 5:35:00.; rdo timing from measured cue WAV duration.

subtitle_zh: 这座外墙非常特别的建筑就是当年的“北极兄弟会会馆”，
subtitle_en: This was the Arctic Brotherhood Hall.
notes: draft row 7 segment 1/2; source time 6:20:20.; rdo timing from measured cue WAV duration.

subtitle_zh: 它的外墙全部由漂流木拼接而成。
subtitle_en: Its facade is made entirely of driftwood.
notes: draft row 7 segment 2/2; source time 6:20:20.; rdo timing from measured cue WAV duration.

subtitle_zh: 万神殿曾是淘金热时期最豪华的剧院之一，
subtitle_en: The Pantheon was once a top Gold Rush theater,
notes: draft row 8 segment 1/2; source time 6:58:16.; rdo timing from measured cue WAV duration.

subtitle_zh: 也是当年歌舞表演的重要场所。
subtitle_en: and a major venue for music and dance.
notes: draft row 8 segment 2/2; source time 6:58:16.; rdo timing from measured cue WAV duration.

subtitle_zh: 前面这座很醒目的石头建筑是史凯威市政厅.
subtitle_en: This stone building is Skagway City Hall.
notes: draft row 9 segment 1/3; source time 8:20:01.; rdo timing from measured cue WAV duration.

subtitle_zh: 它最初计划作为一所学校使用。
subtitle_en: It was first planned as a school.
notes: draft row 9 segment 2/3; source time 8:20:01.; rdo timing from measured cue WAV duration.

subtitle_zh: 它也是史凯威唯一的石砌建筑，
subtitle_en: It is Skagway's only stone building.
notes: draft row 9 segment 3/3; source time 8:20:01.; rdo timing from measured cue WAV duration.

subtitle_zh: 这里是历史悠久的 柯姆斯奇珍店。
subtitle_en: This is historic Kirmse's Curios.
notes: draft row 10; source time 8:56:22.; rdo timing from measured cue WAV duration.

subtitle_zh: 这栋黄绿相间的建筑是历史上的林奇与肯尼迪男装及百货商店
subtitle_en: This yellow-green building was Lynch and Kennedy.
notes: draft row 11; source time 9:05:05.; rdo timing from measured cue WAV duration.

subtitle_zh: 来到史凯威,我们当然也没有错过这里很有名的克朗代克炸面饼店,
subtitle_en: In Skagway, we had to stop for Klondike Doughboy.
notes: draft row 12 segment 1/5; source time 9:16:17.; rdo timing from measured cue WAV duration.

subtitle_zh: 刚出炉的 油炸面饼外酥内软,
subtitle_en: Fresh doughboys are crisp outside and soft inside,
notes: draft row 12 segment 2/5; source time 9:16:17.; rdo timing from measured cue WAV duration.

subtitle_zh: 再撒上一层肉桂糖和糖粉，香气扑鼻。
subtitle_en: with cinnamon sugar and powdered sugar.
notes: draft row 12 segment 3/5; source time 9:16:17.; rdo timing from measured cue WAV duration.

subtitle_zh: 虽然只是简单的一块炸面团，却成为许多游客来到史凯威最难忘的味道。
subtitle_en: Simple fried dough, but many visitors remember it.
notes: draft row 12 segment 4/5; source time 9:16:17.; rdo timing from measured cue WAV duration.

subtitle_zh: 我们也买了一些，趁热尝尝。
subtitle_en: We bought some and tried them hot.
notes: draft row 12 segment 5/5; source time 9:16:17.; rdo timing from measured cue WAV duration.

subtitle_zh: 逛完 史凯威市中心，我们沿着原路慢慢返回港口。
subtitle_en: After downtown, we walk back to the port.
notes: draft row 13; source time normalized from 11:33:33.; rdo timing from measured cue WAV duration.

subtitle_zh: 这是我们第二次来到 史凯威。
subtitle_en: This is our second visit to Skagway.
notes: draft row 14 segment 1/9; source time 11:45:15.; rdo timing from measured cue WAV duration.

subtitle_zh: 和上一次一样，这座小城给我的感觉并不只是一个邮轮港口。
subtitle_en: Again, it feels like more than a cruise port.
notes: draft row 14 segment 2/9; source time 11:45:15.; rdo timing from measured cue WAV duration.

subtitle_zh: 短短几条街上仍然保存着许多克朗代克淘金热留下来的建筑和故事。
subtitle_en: A few streets still hold Gold Rush stories.
notes: draft row 14 segment 3/9; source time 11:45:15.; rdo timing from measured cue WAV duration.

subtitle_zh: 上午的市区漫步也只是今天行程的前半段。
subtitle_en: This walk is only the first half of today.
notes: draft row 14 segment 4/9; source time 11:45:15.; rdo timing from measured cue WAV duration.

subtitle_zh: 接下来，我们将回到港口，
subtitle_en: Next, we return to the port,
notes: draft row 14 segment 5/9; source time 11:45:15.; rdo timing from measured cue WAV duration.

subtitle_zh: 登上白隘口景观列车。
subtitle_en: and board the White Pass train.
notes: draft row 14 segment 6/9; source time 11:45:15.; rdo timing from measured cue WAV duration.

subtitle_zh: 沿着一百多年前淘金者走过的方向进入群山，
subtitle_en: We head into the mountains like the old prospectors,

subtitle_zh: 开始今天下午最精彩的一段旅程
subtitle_en: starting the best part of the afternoon.
